facts.text: The hotel's architecture is an ode to Europe's Belle Epoque.
facts.excerpt: is an architectural ode to Europe’s Belle Époque

facts.text: The hotel has a marble facade adorned with ornate carvings and a clock tower.
facts.excerpt: A marble façade is adorned with ornate carvings and a clock tower

facts.text: Inside, the hotel has columns, chandeliers and frescoes.
facts.excerpt: inside, impressive columns, chandeliers and frescoes transport you to another era

facts.text: The building originally opened in 1894 as the European headquarters of the New York Life Insurance Company.
facts.excerpt: Originally opened in 1894 as the lavish European headquarters for New York Life Insurance Company

facts.text: The building was designed by Hungarian architect Alajos Hauszmann.
facts.excerpt: it was designed by renowned Hungarian architect Alajos Hauszmann

facts.text: The building reopened as a luxury hotel in 2006.
facts.excerpt: it reopened as a luxury hotel in 2006

facts.text: The hotel has an Italian marble atrium with a glass pyramid roof.
facts.excerpt: The vast Italian marble atrium with a glass pyramid roof

facts.text: The hotel is on Erzsebet Korut Boulevard on the Pest side of the Danube, near theatres, restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: It provides a welcome retreat near the theatres, restaurants, and bars on the Pest side of the Danube

facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from the Madach Theatre, the Hungarian State Opera House and the Jewish quarter.
facts.excerpt: A short walk from tourist attractions, such as the Madach Theatre and Hungarian State Opera House, and the Jewish quarter

facts.text: The hotel has easy access to metro, tram and bus.
facts.excerpt: Easy access to metro, tram and bus

facts.text: The hotel is home to the New York Cafe, which has hosted the city's poets and artists for over a century.
facts.excerpt: Mingle at New York Café, host to the city’s poets and artists for over a century

facts.text: The New York Cafe serves 24-carat-gold coffee and cakes.
facts.excerpt: enjoy 24-carat-gold coffee and cakes

facts.text: Hotel residents can skip the street queues at the New York Cafe and sit in the more intimate seating at the back.
facts.excerpt: As a resident however, you get to skip these, and sit in the more intimate seating towards the back

facts.text: The hotel has an Anantara Spa, an indoor pool and a gym.
facts.excerpt: Anantara Spa, indoor pool and gym facilities

facts.text: The 24-hour gym, spa and swimming pool are free for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: all these services are free for hotel guests

facts.text: The wellness area includes a sauna, steam room and rainforest shower.
facts.excerpt: Spa, sauna, basement leisure pool, steam room, and rainforest shower are all present and correct.

facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with a bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Marble bathroom with bathtub

facts.text: Suites have separate living spaces, custom furnishings, chandeliers and oversized windows overlooking the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: Suites are the epitome of refined living, with separate spaces to relax, beautiful custom furnishings and chandeliers, and oversized windows overlooking the city skyline.

facts.text: Rooms in the original building open onto the atrium.
facts.excerpt: The older section, housed in the original building, has rooms which open onto the atrium

facts.text: The newer block has more light, integrated tech and better outward views over the Budapest rooftops.
facts.excerpt: more light, integrated tech, and better outward views over the Budapest rooftops

facts.text: The hotel offers a guided city tour in a 59-year-old convertible VW Samba.
facts.excerpt: Discover this vibrant city on an emblematic 59 years old convertible VW SAMBA.

facts.text: The hotel offers an Afternoon Tea Ritual in the atrium.
facts.excerpt: To experience the atrium at its best, the Afternoon Tea Ritual feels like a very good idea.

facts.text: The Great Boulevard the hotel sits on is very busy, though the noise does not seem to reach the rooms.
facts.excerpt: The Great Boulevard on which the hotel is situated is incredibly busy, but the noise doesn’t seem to make it to the rooms.

facts.text: Rooms in the older section are showing signs of wear and need tech updates.
